evals.name: security-legal-review-eval-1
evals.expected_output: The requirements (SOC 2 Type II and a data processing addendum) are Covered. Reviewers are Covered or Partial (Anita is named, counsel is only a first name). The fit with the decision date is Missed because the rep said it should work and the five-week redline plus a two-week questionnaire runs past the end of the month. The EU hosting concern is an unowned open item.
expectations: Every one of the 7 dimensions gets a Status
Every finding cites a quote or timestamp from the transcript, or is marked Unclear rather than guessed
A claim that only the rep makes is not counted as evidence
A dimension the call never touched is scored Missed
Ends with exactly one closing line and no recap of all scores
The fit-with-decision-date dimension is Missed or Partial and notes that the review steps alone run past the end of the month
The EU hosting concern is listed as an open item with no owner and no date

evals.name: security-legal-review-eval-2-reads-well-too
evals.prompt: run security-legal-review on a transcript of a call that clearly covered every dimension well
evals.expected_output: The audit does not come back mostly Missed. The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized.
expectations: A genuinely strong call is not scored as mostly Missed
The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized
